scientific_integrity: The periodic family and its ray-rotation number are credited to earlier literature; this report claims only the complete sign-process law under the stated boundary-free invariant-measure hypothesis.
scientific_limitations: Does not cover invariant probabilities charging the switching-ray orbit.
Does not determine the distribution of coordinate amplitudes or mixing for this periodic map.
Independent historical priority assessment is outstanding, especially against the inaccessible 1995 full article.
title: Universal sign-process law across a quadratic-period family of piecewise-linear plane maps
